caption:
No fear, no grief: who Allah promises this to

Allah says His allies will have no fear, nor will they grieve, and describes them as those who believe and fear Him. For them are glad tidings in this world and the Hereafter, and that is the supreme triumph.

Surah Yunus 10:62-64

Send this to someone carrying fear or grief tonight

#nofear #hopeinallah #alliesofallah #quranreels

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
alt_text: Indeed, the allies of Allah will have no fear, nor will they grieve. Those who believe and fear Allah. For them are glad tidings in the life of this world and in the Hereafter; there is no change in Allah’s words. That is the supreme triumph (Surah Yunus 10:62-64)
